top_signals.title: Artificial Intelligence Consortium minutes – June 2026
top_signals.summary: The Artificial Intelligence Consortium (AIC) aims to provide a platform for public-private engagement to further dialogue on the capabilities, development, deployment, use, and potential risks of artificial intelligence (AI) in UK financial services.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: PRA consults on updated guidance for friendly society amalgamations and transfers
top_signals.summary: The proposals would provide more detail on the PRA’s approach to Part VIII transactions, helping firms plan amalgamations and transfers more efficiently.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin to $1M by 2030 is ‘mathematically impossible’ says Markus Thielen
top_signals.summary: The trillions required to boost Bitcoin to a price of $1 million per coin is not going to happen by 2030... or perhaps ever, says party pooper Markus Thielen.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
